process: the monarchy is hereditary; lieutenant governor appointed by the monarch; chief minister indirectly elected by the Tynwald for a 5-year term (eligible for second term)
results: 2021: Alfred CANNAN (independent) elected chief minister; Tynwald House of Keys vote - 21 of 24; 2016: Howard QUAYLE elected chief minister; Tynwald House of Keys vote - 21 of 33
cabinet: Council of Ministers appointed by the lieutenant governor
